  identity         ssh key {home}/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub (agent-proxy)
                   THE SANDBOX CAN ACT AS THIS ACCOUNT. It can push to any
                   repository this key reaches and authenticate to any host that
                   trusts it, for as long as the run lasts. No private key
                   enters the sandbox and your other keys cannot be enumerated
                   or used.
                   signing key {home}/.ssh/id_ed25519_signing.pub (agent-proxy)
                   THE SANDBOX CAN SIGN COMMITS AND TAGS AS YOU — vouching as
                   a human, for code it wrote itself, on any repository. snug
                   generates commit.gpgsign = true, so commits inside are signed
                   by default. The agent protocol carries no purpose, so either
                   pinned key can be used for either job.
                   git Some One <some.one@example.com>
                   gh some-one @ github.com
